question: In Aditya - L1, the first Indian mission to study the Sun, what does L1 stand for?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lagrangian point 1.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Aditya-L1, the first Indian mission to study the Sun, **L1** stands for **Lagrange point 1**.
 
• L1 in Aditya-L1 stands for **Lagrange point 1**, a stable point in space located between the Earth and the Sun, about 1.5 million kilometers from Earth.
 
• **Reason for Location**
 
 
• **Stable position**: The gravitational forces of the Earth and Sun balance out, allowing the spacecraft to maintain a steady orbit.
 
• **Continuous viewing**: The spacecraft can continuously observe the Sun without interruptions from eclipses or occultations.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Aditya-L1 spacecraft** was launched on **September 2, 2023**, and was inserted into its halo orbit around the L1 point on **January 6, 2024**.
 
• The **Aditya-L1 mission** is India's first space-based solar observatory, aimed at studying the **Sun's chromosphere, photosphere, and corona** to understand the dynamics of the Sun's atmosphere.
 
• The mission has a projected life of **five years**.
 
• **Payloads**:
 
 
• **Solar Ultraviolet Imaging Telescope (SUIT)**: Captures images of the Sun's photosphere and chromosphere.
 
• **L1 Orbiting X-ray Spectrometer (HEL1OS)**: Studies X-ray flares from the Sun.
 
• **Magnetometer**: Measures interplanetary magnetic fields at L1.
 
 
 
• **Collaboration**: Science payloads were developed by **Indian laboratories** in collaboration with **ISRO**.
 
• **Objective**: The mission will help us understand the **thermal and magnetic phenomena** of the Sun, which can cause disturbances in near-Earth space.
